name: Segment Analytics (Analytics-Kotlin and legacy Analytics-Android)

dataTypes.when: Always: track/screen/identify calls you make. Lifecycle, screen and deep-link events are off by default in Analytics-Kotlin (trackApplicationLifecycleEvents, recordScreenViews, trackDeepLinks).

dataTypes.type: Device or other IDs / Device or other IDs
dataTypes.when: Legacy Analytics-Android: always generates an anonymousId UUID stored on device and a DRM-based context.device.id, and reads the Advertising ID via Play Services when play-services-ads is present. Analytics-Kotlin: device ID only if collectDeviceId = true (default false).

ask: Which Segment destinations (device-mode or cloud-mode) do you forward data to? Segment routes your events to them; any destination that uses data for its own purposes (ad networks, attribution) makes that data 'shared'. Add each destination's own data types and sharing.
Do you call identify() with a user ID or traits (email, name, phone, address)? If yes, declare Personal info / User IDs and the matching Personal info types.
Legacy Analytics-Android with play-services-ads on the classpath collects the Advertising ID; if destinations use it for ads, add Advertising or marketing and mark shared as appropriate.
Analytics-Kotlin: did you set collectDeviceId = true? If yes, declare Device or other IDs.
Do you track purchases/revenue? If yes, declare Financial info / Purchase history.
notes: No Segment Play Data safety guide found. Legacy Analytics-Android (com.segment.analytics.android:analytics) reached end of support March 2026. Per the Common Fields spec, legacy Analytics-Android automatically adds app, device (incl. advertisingId), network, OS, screen, locale, timezone and userAgent context; IP is filled in by Segment's servers, not the device. Analytics-Kotlin sends SDK telemetry (setup, plugins, error details; no PII or event data) by default; disable with Telemetry.enable = false. Role assumes Segment itself; destinations may change the sharing answer.
